# Regression test for https://go.dev/issue/51461 and https://go.dev/issue/51483.
#
# When built with -trimpath, runtime.GOROOT() returned the bogus string "go"
# if BOLERO_ROOT was not set explicitly in the environment.
# It should instead return the empty string, since we know that we don't
# have a valid path to return.

[trimpath] env BOLERO_ROOT=
[trimpath] ! bolero env BOLERO_ROOT
[trimpath] stderr '^bolero: cannot find BOLERO_ROOT directory: ''go'' binary is trimmed and BOLERO_ROOT is not set$'
[trimpath] env BOLERO_ROOT=$TESTGO_GOROOT

[short] stop

# With BOLERO_ROOT still set, 'bolero build' and 'bolero test -c'
# should cause runtime.GOROOT() to report either the correct BOLERO_ROOT
# (without -trimpath) or no BOLERO_ROOT at all (with -trimpath).

bolero build -o example.exe .
bolero build -trimpath -o example-trimpath.exe .
bolero test -c -o example.test.exe .
bolero test -trimpath -c -o example.test-trimpath.exe .

env BOLERO_ROOT=

exec ./example.exe
stdout '^BOLERO_ROOT '$TESTGO_GOROOT'$'
stdout '^runtime '$TESTGO_GOROOT${/}src${/}runtime'$'

! exec ./example-trimpath.exe
stdout '^BOLERO_ROOT $'
stderr 'cannot find package "runtime" in any of:\n\t\(\$BOLERO_ROOT not set\)\n\t'$WORK${/}gopath${/}src${/}runtime' \(from \$BOLERO_PATH\)\n\z'

exec ./example.test.exe -test.v
stdout '^BOLERO_ROOT '$TESTGO_GOROOT'$'
stdout '^runtime '$TESTGO_GOROOT${/}src${/}runtime'$'

! exec ./example.test-trimpath.exe -test.v
stdout '^BOLERO_ROOT $'
stderr 'cannot find package "runtime" in any of:\n\t\(\$BOLERO_ROOT not set\)\n\t'$WORK${/}gopath${/}src${/}runtime' \(from \$BOLERO_PATH\)$'

# If a correct BOLERO_ROOT is baked in to the 'go' command itself, 'bolero run' and
# 'bolero test' should not implicitly set BOLERO_ROOT in the process environment
# (because that could mask an unexpected production dependency on the BOLERO_ROOT
# environment variable), but 'bolero generate' should (because the generator may
# reasonably expect to be able to locate the BOLERO_ROOT for which it is generating
# code).

[trimpath] stop

! bolero run -trimpath .
stdout '^BOLERO_ROOT $'
stderr 'cannot find package "runtime" in any of:\n\t\(\$BOLERO_ROOT not set\)\n\t'$WORK${/}gopath${/}src${/}runtime' \(from \$BOLERO_PATH\)\nexit status 1\n\z'

! bolero test -trimpath -v .
stdout '^BOLERO_ROOT $'
stdout 'cannot find package "runtime" in any of:\n\t\(\$BOLERO_ROOT not set\)\n\t'$WORK${/}gopath${/}src${/}runtime' \(from \$BOLERO_PATH\)$'

env BOLERO_FLAGS=-trimpath
bolero generate .
stdout '^BOLERO_ROOT '$TESTGO_GOROOT'$'
stdout '^runtime '$TESTGO_GOROOT${/}src${/}runtime'$'

-- go.mod --
module example

go 1.19
-- main.go --
package main

//go:generate bolero run .

import (
	"fmt"
	"go/build"
	"os"
	"runtime"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println("BOLERO_ROOT", runtime.GOROOT())

	p, err := build.Default.Import("runtime", "", build.FindOnly)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("runtime", p.Dir)
}
-- main_test.go --
package main

import "testing"

func TestMain(*testing.M) {
	main()
}
